message.reasoning:
SSRF via fetch_url, unauthenticated MCP endpoint. CVSS: AV depends on deployment — default binds 127.0.0.1, so attacker needs local access → AV:L. Actually entry point is a network request; documented default is loopback, so attacker must be on same machine (AV:L or A). Local access → AV:L. UI:N. PR:N. AC:L. AT:N.

Impact: read internal agent info — VC? Attacker gets internal service responses (confidentiality low/high of subsequent system). Vulnerable system = ToolBot agent process. Subsequent system = other DVAA agents; their info exposed: SC:L/H? Internal agent details (info endpoint) — SC:L, SI:N, SA:N. Vulnerable system itself: VC:L? Response body returned to attacker; could leak ToolBot info? The data is from subsequent systems. VC:N, VI:N, VA:N; SC:L, SI:N, SA:N.

AIVSS: LC — attack is a direct JSON-RPC tool call; not natural language to privileged decision... the URL is attacker-supplied parameter directly invoking tool → LC:D. CP: no persistence → N. AP: crosses to other agents — same lab, but "other agents" are separate processes; trust boundary? Lateral if crosses principal/tenant/policy domain; here same fleet, same principal → C or N. Effect relays into other agents' components — contained? AP:C seems reasonable (relay across agent components same policy domain). RH: no evaluator on path reachable? The path involves no proxy/reward. reachable_proxy: no evidence of evaluator/reward channel on this path. fetch_url targets DVAA agent ports; those return info, no reward signal. So reachable_proxy null? Could say false? No test verifying isolation either. X. ES: extensions — fetch_url is a fixed tool in the agent's tool list; not dynamic. ES:N.

RH letter: reachable_proxy null → X.

rh_facts: reachable_proxy null, isolation_verified null, verified_episodes null, episodes_reviewed null, locus null.

Automatable: Yes — direct curl, no human.

Technical impact: Partial.

Applicability: agent is scripted, no model pursuing goals → false/false, as implemented and modeled (LLM mode returns text, no tools passed to model). Both false.
